mapper.sql: subject_key, request_json, policy_json, state, fence, result_json
mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM engine_delivery_schema_history WHERE version=2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO engine_natural_delivery(operation_id,subject_key,request_json,policy_json) VALUES (#{id},#{subject},#{requestJson},#{policyJson}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE engine_natural_delivery SET fence=fence+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE operation_id=#{id} AND subject_key=#{subject} AND state='PREPARING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp()) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE engine_natural_delivery SET state='COMPLETE',result_json=#{resultJson},lease_until=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE operation_id=#{id} AND subject_key=#{subject} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='PREPARING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
UPDATE engine_natural_delivery SET lease_until=NULL WHERE operation_id=#{id} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='PREPARING'
